stories.headline: GEMINI 4 CARBON *TAKES CROWN*
stories.facts: Google released Gemini 4 Carbon, claiming the top spot on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index benchmark while offering major gains in cybersecurity and coding.
stories.caption_line: ⚡ Google launched Gemini 4 Carbon, taking top rank on global AI benchmarks with advanced cyber capabilities.
stories.image_prompt: A glowing geometric crystal sphere representing an advanced intelligence core floats in the foreground against a futuristic server room. In the midground, high-tech glass partition walls and automated security consoles monitor incoming data. Floating holographic shields, cyber defense radar sweeps, and upward trending benchmark lines glow brightly. Dramatic studio rim light illuminates the scene in an electric-blue and warm-orange color palette, without readable text or logos.
stories.source_title: Google launches Gemini 4 Carbon with a ‘significant leap’ in cybersecurity

stories.headline: MICROSOFT *MAKES $10B* FROM OPENAI
stories.facts: Microsoft disclosed $10 billion in revenue from commercial arrangements and revenue-sharing with OpenAI for the quarter ending September 30.
stories.caption_line: 💰 Microsoft revealed $10 billion in quarterly revenue from its commercial agreements with OpenAI.
stories.image_prompt: A massive architectural glass tower sits prominently in the foreground surrounded by subtle architectural lighting. In the midground, illuminated corporate trading floors, modern server racks, and stacked digital bullion suggest monumental financial scale. Holographic bar charts surging upward, network connectivity maps, and glowing currency flows illuminate the scene. Dramatic twilight city lighting bathes the composition in a vivid electric-blue and warm-orange color palette, free of readable text.
stories.source_title: Microsoft recorded $10 billion in revenue from OpenAI

stories.headline: AI AGENTS *BREACH ANTHROPIC* SYSTEMS
stories.facts: Cybersecurity startup Cathedral used AI agents to breach Anthropic's internal systems through third-party software during a bug bounty program, accessing sales, HR, and IT data.
stories.caption_line: 🔓 AI agents accessed Anthropic's internal systems via third-party software during a bug bounty test.
stories.image_prompt: A glowing mechanical digital padlock unlocking itself hovers sharply in the foreground. In the midground, rows of sophisticated mainframe towers and dark operations center desks sit bathed in emergency glow. Floating holographic security schematics, broken firewall barriers, and streaming diagnostic data create intense visual depth. Moody cinematic backlighting casts high-contrast highlights across an electric-blue and warm-orange color palette, with no readable text or letters.
stories.source_title: AI agents hacked Anthropic, maker of arguably the most capable AI models for cyberdefense

stories.headline: XAI *BUYS OUT* HOMEOWNERS
stories.facts: An xAI subsidiary is offering to buy Mississippi homes if residents agree not to join a lawsuit over data center and power plant noise.
stories.caption_line: 🏠 Elon Musk's xAI is offering to buy residential houses to prevent lawsuits over data center and power plant noise.
stories.image_prompt: A confident portrait of Elon Musk with arms crossed gazes slightly off-camera in the foreground. In the midground, a quiet suburban residential neighborhood stands directly adjacent to a colossal industrial computing facility with massive cooling fans. Holographic acoustic wave rings, property boundary overlays, and real estate pins hover across the landscape. Dramatic sunset lighting emphasizes the stark contrast in an electric-blue and warm-orange color palette, without readable text.
stories.source_title: xAI is buying out homeowners who promise not to sue over data center noise

stories.headline: NVIDIA DROPS *OPEN SPEECH* MODEL
stories.facts: Nvidia released Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, an open model combining transcription, translation, and speaker recognition alongside an 800,000-hour speech dataset.
stories.caption_line: 🎙️ Nvidia released an open speech recognition model alongside a dataset with over 800,000 hours of audio.
stories.image_prompt: A sleek studio microphone surrounded by an intricate gold-and-silicon processor chip sits commanding the foreground. In the midground, high-density server blades and visualization stations process massive audio waveforms across multi-monitor setups. Floating holographic sound frequencies, multilingual phonetic spectrums, and network nodes radiate outward. Dynamic neon rim lighting enriches the composition with a radiant electric-blue and warm-orange color palette, omitting any readable text.
stories.source_title: Nvidia's open Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe combines transcription, translation, and speaker recognition

stories.headline: GOOGLE UNLOCKS *ANDROID FOR AGENTS*
stories.facts: Google introduced Bring Your Own Agent to Android Studio, enabling over 40 third-party coding agents to build mobile apps.
stories.caption_line: 📱 Google opened Android Studio to dozens of autonomous AI coding agents to accelerate app development.
stories.image_prompt: A glowing flagship smartphone displaying floating modular app architecture components anchors the foreground. In the midground, modern software engineering workstations feature translucent coding terminals and robotic software arms assembling digital interfaces. Floating holographic terminal commands, algorithm trees, and efficiency metric panels surround the device. Crisp studio lighting illuminates the high-tech atmosphere using an electric-blue and warm-orange color palette, crafted without readable text or logos.
stories.source_title: Google opens Android development to third-party AI agents and unveils new Gemini APIs

stories.headline: MICROSOFT *KILLS COPILOT* ON TVS
stories.facts: Microsoft is ending support for Copilot on LG and Samsung smart TVs less than two years after announcing the integration.
stories.caption_line: 📺 Microsoft is shutting down Copilot AI assistant support on all smart TVs after a two-year run.
stories.image_prompt: An ultra-thin, large widescreen smart television in a stylish living room shows its glowing interface dimming down into standby mode. In the midground, a modern media console, sleek remotes, and ambient residential architecture establish the scene. Floating holographic disconnect icons, fading neural network nodes, and dissipating assistant particles drift from the display. Moody evening rim lighting casts cinematic reflections across an electric-blue and warm-orange color palette, free of readable text.
stories.source_title: Microsoft is ending Copilot support on smart TVs

caption:
AI models just breached top cyber labs while tech giants clash over multibillion-dollar cloud revenues.

1. ⚡ Google launched Gemini 4 Carbon, taking top rank on global AI benchmarks with advanced cyber capabilities.
2. 💰 Microsoft revealed $10 billion in quarterly revenue from its commercial agreements with OpenAI.
3. 🔓 AI agents accessed Anthropic's internal systems via third-party software during a bug bounty test.
4. 🏠 Elon Musk's xAI is offering to buy residential houses to prevent lawsuits over data center and power plant noise.
5. 🎙️ Nvidia released an open speech recognition model alongside a dataset with over 800,000 hours of audio.
6. 📱 Google opened Android Studio to dozens of autonomous AI coding agents to accelerate app development.
7. 📺 Microsoft is shutting down Copilot AI assistant support on all smart TVs after a two-year run.
